reason: I'd take the free call and the 15 companies, because that costs me nothing, but I wouldn't sign the pilot yet. A junior SDR in Sofia and an Apollo seat cost about the same as EUR 2,800 for two months, and I keep the person afterwards.
objection: EUR 350 a meeting adds up quickly once the free ones are used, and I've seen agencies count a polite intro call as a 'qualified meeting'. One logistics client getting 45 meetings tells me nothing about selling machinery to German or Romanian buyers.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies include real buyers in my niche that I didn't already know from trade fairs, and the first message in the local language is better than what my own people would write, I would run the pilot.
